name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 41 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2025-08-21, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.85 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
